blocks.text: Your podcast? I’m the one who collates the recordings, checks the microphones, edits it together, attaches the microphones to Stan’s uniforms--
Fine, our podcast. The concept is mine though. It’s my IP.
The concept of recording things and editing them together?
No the... Can I just do my bit?
You need to speak to the front of the mic, not in the top.
Right, we can just edit that bit out.

Ahem. Away from city lights, nestled in the bosom of the United Kingdom’s national parks are villages a plenty, and we’re pleased to welcome you to this one. With its quaint floral arrangements, redundant red telephone booth, quintessentially cutesy cobbled Main Street, two pubs, a post office, and a shop from a major supermarket which shall not be named for fear of terrible repercussions, it has all you could possibly need. Surrounded by rolling countryside and with that faint odour of animal excrement on the breeze it’s exactly what one would hope for in a rural idyll. Just ask Mrs Juniper, who spends every day feeding the ducks from her perch on the park bench by the edge of the babbling brook. Just don’t sit too close to her, and no, not just because of the smell.
Last day for Christmas post. I bloody know it’s the last day to post things before Christmas. That’s why I’m in the arse end of nowhere.
BRIEF AMBIENCE — WIND THROUGH TREES, DISTANT CROW, GRAVEL UNDERFOOT.
FOOTSTEPS SHIFT FROM GRAVEL TO COBBLESTONES AS HE HITS MAIN STREET.
Sound of creepy choir getting louder, and louder.
ONE BEAT OF DEAD SILENCE — THEN THE AMBIENT SOUNDS OF A LARGE GROUP BREATHING, SHUFFLING, TURNING.
The group stirs — shuffling feet, murmured conferring.
Can we help you with something?
Sorry, I was just passing by, didn’t mean to interrupt.
Yes, and again, I’m sorry. Though you are in the middle of the street.
We booked out this street. We had a reservation. Have you got a reservation?
Well you’re occupying it, aren’t you? Standing there like some kind of poorly made imitation wax work. Eyes all agog, forehead so large it could be a billboard.
That’s, needlessly hurtful. My forehead is in the average range.
Because people keep telling you, you’ve got a massive forehead?
Did you check just the size...or the ratio compared to the rest of the face?
That’s... Irrelevant. I’m sorry I interrupted your singing, if you could point me towards the post office I’ll get out of the way.
Right, apologies for calling you a wax work. You’re giving off uncanny valley vibes, I mean, as if you’re not really a person, you are a person, right?
Yes. Thank you. Look, could you tell me where the post office is, please?
I’m going... It’s just... is that blood, on the altar there? And, do choirs usually dress in black and have goat skull masks and...
Course not, hah, I’m going to go now.

It’s all of those things, mixed together. It’s a kind of cocktail, very good for the larynx and it’s also... none of your business. What’s that package in your hands? Is it a nuclear bomb? A nuclear warhead wrapped up like an innocent parcel in brown paper?
No. You know, you’re quite aggressive, not exactly a welcoming village vibe.
Aha, that’s because you are not welcome, now shove off.
And next time you want to stand in the street, remember to make a reservation like the rest of us.
Okay, raising of the beast to devour humanity, annnd 3, 2, 1...
Choir starts again and fades as Stan’s footsteps walk away
UNDER THE FADING CHOIR — A LOW GEOLOGICAL RUMBLE, NOT MUSICAL. SOMETHING RESPONDING. FADES. STAN'S FOOTSTEPS QUICKEN SLIGHTLY.
Bell rings, with sfx of door opening, background noise of a quiet shop
Hello there love, need some help with your package (creepy laugh). I’m always open to some package fondling you know.
Um. I was just hoping to post this.
It’s a package wrapped in paper about the size of a shoebox.
I can see that. Is it a nuclear weapon?
No. Why do people keep asking that?
Because people are worried you might be carrying a nuclear weapon disguised as an innocent package?
Yes but, why is that the first thought people have?

I imagine it’s a product of the ever-increasing paranoia that permeates society mainly through social media. The fact that we are taught to look down on any other group in any way we can, the manipulation of our every waking moment by an army of manipulators who funnel vast fortunes, beyond the comprehension of most people, into making us think, and believe, what they want, regardless of the truth. The fact that making us contrarian to one another, by it’s very nature, makes us easier to control and easier to ‘milk’ like cattle for every moment of our time, and every penny we are worth.
Uh, okay, what’s that got to do with this package being a nuclear weapon.
So it is a nuclear weapon? I can’t believe you’d just walk around--
It is not a nuclear weapon. That would be insane. Why would I come to the arse end of nowhere to post a nuclear weapon?
That’s rude. I think on some level launching a nuclear attack--
Yes, by post, from somewhere like Little Hellington would be quite clever, nobody would see that coming.
Right. (BEAT) Can I post this package?
I’ve not seen you around here before, are you new to the area?
No. I’m just passing through. Does that prevent me from sending a package?
It’s just a bit strange, isn’t it, Stan? Why would you have a package to send to your mother from a middle-of-nowhere village like this?
I suppose...wait, I didn’t say my name was Stan, how did you know this was for my mother?

It’s on the package, right there in big black marker. It says ‘To Mam, From Stan’. You’re going to need to write her address on it though, posties probably won’t know who your Mam is, or maybe they would know, and that might be worse!
Oh, hah, right. I need a label for it. Sorry. There was this choir outside, slightly creepy music, I think it’s put me a little on edge. Kept going on about reserving the street as if--
You walked up Main Street? You can’t be doing that, it’s booked. Didn’t you check the reservations?
No I didn’t check... where would you even--
Look the sign up sheet’s right here.
And that’s where I book the street, is it?

Yup. The demonic choir have it booked, see, right there. Performance for the final reckoning and the end of everything, five o’clock until six. Huh, looks like we don’t have any reservations at all after that. Not a single one...ever...again?
... Look, can I send this or not? I was hoping to get a sticker to write the address on with and--

Woah, hah, wow. You scared the shit out of me. That’s an amazing costume. Seven foot skeleton with long black robes and a, uh, scythe, very impressive, realistic. Ooh, please don’t take me, I’m too young, hah...
Thank you. I do the tailoring myself, by hand, lack of skin can make tactile things tricky but at least I don’t need a thimble.(BEAT) It really swishes, listen.
Hello Death, not seen you in a while.
No? Time’s difficult when you’re, y’know, all encompassing. Are you Stan?
Stanley Waters, son of Eric and Veronica?

Yes. Obviously, or I wouldn’t be here right now. Do you see what I have to deal with Marjorie? Honestly, people have no respect for the natural order of things. You were supposed to be killed in a, frankly horrific, car accident coming out of a service station on the the M25.
A what? This isn’t funny. I’m a very careful driver-
Oh you weren’t driving, you were walking towards your, quite crappy, little car.

GRIM	It was a lorry, tricky word that, lorry. No tongue you see, so I really have to focus to make the word... anyway, a lorry takes a wrong turn and instead of going into the heavy goods vehicle section it ends up in the passenger vehicles section, it gets turned around, hops a curb, and then gets hit by an SUV, don’t worry, nobody was hurt, but the lorry tips and spills its contents, which land on you.
Oh it gets worse. The lorry is carrying toys. So you’re crushed under the weight of them.
What, like, action figures. I mean it’s bad but-
No. ‘adult’ toys. You end up suffocating beneath a very realistic, but fake posterior.
Yes, a right arse, the whole thing.
That’s weird, and kind of gross. Why would you talk to people like this? Is this how you spend your time? Dressing up and thinking of obscure ways for people to die?
Once again, thank you, I did decide to go with the formal gown today. It was a whim really. I did just say it was horrific, did you think I was lying? The posterior had a ‘twerking’ function.

Your behaviour is wrong, it’s not okay. I’m not saying you’re a bad person, but you need to take a look at what you’re doing. This place is creepy. You know what, I’m going to go. I’ll carry on to another village
Good luck with that at this time. It’s the last day for Christmas post you know?
Yes. I know. I have received many notifications about that specific fact. I’m sure I’ve time to go to a different post office.
Nearest one is fourteen miles away, be shut when you get there. Anyway, you’ll never make it there without getting into a horrific accident, will he Death?
Not if I have any say in it. Which I do. Because I’m Death.
So this is him, is it?
Yes. It appears to be. Sorry.
Well, beggars can’t be choosers. Welcome to Little Hellington, Stan, you’re going to love it here... oh, actually that’s quite unlikely, but you’ll be here, which is... something.
Don’t worry Stan, you toddle back to the parking by the Dog and Whistle, hop in your crappy little car, and take a nice drive. There’s a good chap.
I wouldn’t do that if I were you, Stan. Anyway, you’re more than welcome here. Come on, let me fondle your package.
I... can you stop saying that? And you, was that supposed to be a threat?

No. I would never threaten anyone. I’m a pacifist you know, also pescatarian, which is like a vegetarian only I eat fish. It’s not relevant, but I like to tell people. Anyway, I was just telling you what will happen.
Telling me what’s going to happen?

Yes. It’s also going to rain later, if that’s of interest. Seems less pertinent. Oh, and your package will get there on time and your mother will be very pleased with the nice little china house you picked out for her, puts it next to the ones she already has on the shelves in the living room. Not pride of place though, that goes to the one that was made with real tiny bricks.
But this one has an actual bell in the tower that works, and it’s not a house, it’s clearly a church.
Oh yes, love, that’s the important part of what he just said.
Wait, how did...where did he go? Oh that’s just cheap. Trying to scare me into thinking that was actually Death. This is childish.
He does that. Just vanishes into thin air.
Well that’s hardly supernatural, is it? He’s just ducked behind something, or there’s a trap door. Is this all some kind of scam?
Used to be that he’d have all these smoke effects and dramatic music, but there’s been a lot of budget cuts.
He was really upset when they took his smoke machine and the little bluetooth speaker he used.
He isn’t death. I hope you get someone more gullible next time for your rubbish internet prank stuff.
Ness! Vanessa, can you come out here, the new bloke just arrived, and he doesn’t believe that Death was just in the postoffice.
It’s really cold in here...what’s... What’s going on?
I probably shouldn’t have touched him.

Why howdy there! JimBob Jimboberson here, and today I want to talk to you about something very close to my heart. There were times in my life where I struggled with anxiety, stress, and uncontrollable rage. I knew there was a way to improve things but instead I was visited by a twisted creature in the night who whispered in my ear the agonising prospects of eternal damnation, it seeped into my subconsciousness until I could no longer distinguish it from my own thoughts, and finally it tipped me over the edge, so I lashed out at others, harming the people I loved and everyone around me. Oh god, I’ve done terrible, unspeakable things...So, if you think you’re one little push away from a slide into an existential crisis, if pushing your buttons could turn you into a murderous fiend, get in touch with Nether-Help, we’re here to give you that little nudge that throws you into the Abyss.
Nether-Help is a subsidiary of the Fifth Circle of Hell group, services may include surcharges against your soul, attempts to push you over the edge are not a guarantee of induced murderous intent.
Wha? What the hell was that?
Whoops, looks like your bag for life has run into a little strife.
I hope you die Claire, you stuck up--
At Misery and Suffering you now get a free Bag with every purchase over ten pounds.
I had a bag, Claire. It broke. It’s not like--

These bags aren’t just any old bag either, not even a bag for life! We’re calling them a bag of Everlasting....torment. Made from human skin and proven to have a tensile strength up to five times greater than other supermarket own brand bags for life.
That’s right, and our Misery club cardholders with over 5000 points can request bags made from the skin of anyone of their choosing.
Already have someone in mind, Susan? Wait, what are you doing Susan? Susan?
Hi, yes, I’ve just heard about your new bags of everlasting torment....yes I am a misery club member...
SUSAN?? Please, I’m sorry, Susan? Oh god no...NO...
What is going on? Where am I?

You’re dreaming in Hell’s Shallows. Thanks for tuning in, unless you’re a resident of the Shallows, in which case please ensure you get your minimum eight hours of non-stop Shallow-time. On today’s schedule we have three hours of season finales, all of which end on huge cliffhangers, and yes, we can confirm that none of those shows will be renewed for a second season. Any attempts at fan-fiction to resolve things will be met with severe legal action...
[OVER TOP OF ADVERTISEMENT/NARRATOR] Wake up newbie.

We’ve also got season thirteen of Hate Island, in this week’s challenge we separate the camp into two groups, but only one of the groups gets food, will war break out? Will there be another murder? Is this the week the islanders finally descend into cannibalism? That’s always my favourite point in the season.
[OVER TOP OF ADVERTISEMENT/NARRATOR] Um, Marjorie, he’s probably caught in a sleep cycle.
[OVER TOP OF ADVERTISEMENT/NARRATOR] Stan, you have to turn off the R.E.M.
But first, here’s, ‘being judged by someone else’s parents’, don’t forget, our artificial intelligence is in your head, these parents are talking about you, and they know every secret--
Ow. What the F... Wait, what? I was having the strangest...

Okay, calm down. I’m beginning to think you might not have been the best candidate for the job. I’ve got to nip back upstairs, but don’t worry. Argus will be with you in a minute, and he’s.. a person? Good luck.
Footsteps to stairs, and sounds of heavy door opening and being bolted again.
Listen here you foul snivelling horror show reject. You can’t seriously think I believe you’re here to visit your aunt, can you?
Why’s that so hard to believe? She’s my favourite aunt.
I’m just having a hard time believing you’re not here for something more nefarious. Says here your full name is... Demaazg...Demagogrzz... Whatever it is, it doesn’t sound very friendly.
You can’t stop me just because I have an unusual name, that’s profiling.
That’s not why I stopped you though, is it?
Is it the way I look? Because that’s just as-
Nope. It isn’t even the fact that you’re an eight foot tall, six armed creature of shadow with a retractable internal jaw, and more teeth than a kleptomaniac dentist.
Why are you looking at me like that?

I was trying to be culturally sensitive, is it appropriation? It’s so tricky nowadays getting the right balance. I want to show I’m willing to be a part of everything, and that I’m on your team, but if I take it too far I get into trouble for-
Where did the skin come from, scum bag?
Oh. Oh, why do you have to be so rude? I made a social foe-par, there’s no need for this kind of treatment. I borrowed it from a security guard.
Human’s don’t shed their skin like a reptile, buddy.
You killed someone, peeled off their skin, and then tried to climb into it.

There we go. DNA checking, bound to be one of ours isn’t it... Oh, Jameson, that’s a shame, everybody liked Dan Jameson. Huh, probably should’ve recognised him. So, that would mean you breached the accords and are...
About to be turned into soup.
Now hang on a minute. I came in here with nothing but good intentions. Sure, I made a mistake with the whole cultural appropriation thing.
It’s more the murder thing, really.

Ah, well. He stepped into our realm. Our traditions state that anyone who isn’t invited can be killed instantly. I mean, I’m not in complete agreement, but the zero tolerance to immigration strategy was a platform the Mistress of Blood ran on, and the people did have their say.
The ones who survived the swarming horde of death did.
Right, democracy at its finest. So this human. He was on your side of the boundary, was he?
Yup. I wouldn’t have devoured him...um, wouldn’t have borrowed his clothes-
Skin. It’s not clothes. We wear clothes on top of the skin.
Ah, wondered why there weren’t any washing instructions. There’s a lot of layers though, it does get confusing.
Skin isn’t a layer...it’s skin. You said he was on your side?
Can someone contact my aunt? She’s going to be worrying about where I am.
Goddamn shadow creatures wearing our own skins acting like they’ve just put something in the wrong pissing wheelie bin. Absolute-
Major, would you like me to call the directorate about the individual in interrogation room one?

I would like to do that, Major, however I am cursed to inhabit this place for all eternity, and part of my penance is to serve as an assistant to all those acting in official capacity for the defence of humankind. If I don’t listen in...things go wrong.
Must you remind me every single time I ask you to piss off.

Sadly, yes. It’s part of the curse. Trust me it’s more tedious for me than it is for you. You only hear it when you tell me to shut up. If I had to think about the number of times I repeat it in any given day, all on the off chance that someone is listening in and needs some quick exposition--
Vanessa. Prepare the death in service package for Dan Jameson.
Dan? But I could’ve sworn I saw him walk into interrogation 1 just a minute ago.

That was a shadow creature wearing his skin. It didn’t even fit. It’s got six arms, are you really telling me you didn’t notice the six arms? What about the tail? Or all the teeth? You thought the huge glistening shadow creature wearing human skin was Dan?
Well. He’s been drinking protein shakes. I assumed he’d overdone it at the gym.
It barely covered a quarter of him!
I can’t judge people on how revealing their attire is.
Are you going to destroy the creature?
Probably, but I need to find out if Dan screwed up first.
The new agent is on his way.
A new recruit? Bloody Death, he knew this had happened, didn’t he? Well, I’ve got a nice introductory task.
I know, I know, he’s called Dan, they’re always called Dan.
Hi Dan. We’ve got a shadow creature-
That’s a creature of infinite darkness from the void realm, a region of eternal torment.
In interrogation one. It’s wearing the skin of Dan jameson and it claims that old Dan stepped across their boundary. So, new Dan-
Actually, it’s Stan. I think I’ve been kidnapped.
Kidnapped. I’m being held against my will. You’re one of them aren’t you-
Not the kidnapping thing, your name.
Oh. Right, it’s all mistaken identity. Hah, well now it makes sense. My name’s Stan, not Dan, short for Stanley.
Stan? Vanessa, what the hell is this?
I’m sorry major, could you be more specific? What the hell is what? You don’t seem to be pointing at anything.
Oh. That’s better. Very assertive pointing, major. That is the new person who arrived this afternoon.
Your smart speaker is amazing. What is going on?
Vanessa! Why is his name, Stan?

Well, it’s likely that his parents named him Stanley and people decided to shorten it to Stan to alleviate the burden of a whole extra syllable, people are inherently lazy. Though, now that I think about it, he might have changed his name by deed poll, though why someone would pick Stanley when there’s so many other names to choose from.

They’re supposed to be called Dan. We had an agreement that all the new agents are called Dan. Now we’re going to have to relabel everything and then he’s going to die and we’ll have to change it all again. It’s just inconsiderate. Bloody paper pushers sticking their nose in, sending void fodder over here as if it means nothing.
The major can be a bit... Ranty.
Listen, Stan, your name is now Dan, am I clear?

Good. Congratulations on being chosen for the most noble of causes, blah, blah, blah. Your locker has your name on it, go get in your uniform. We’ve got a potential boundary breach that needs patching up.

We have, my what? I’m sorry, I’ve no idea what’s going on. I am Stan, you have the wrong person. Oh, will you look at the time. I’m pretty sure my parking is about to run out. Why don’t I just nip out and top that up and we can return to this.
You don’t want to go wandering around here after nightfall, especially if you’ve got no idea what’s going on, got it, Dan?

Stan. I think I’ll be fine, thanks. I imagine your crime rate is a fair bit lower than most places I’ve lived. Or is there a notorious wheelbarrow gang in the area? Maybe someone’s been clipping unattended rose bushes, children ignoring no ball games signs, heaven’s above--
I don’t think he’s got the whole....um...
Right. Dan, I’d like you to come with me to interrogation room 1. This should clear things up a little bit.

Interrogation room? Oh no, I’ve stumbled into little guantanamo bay, water-boarding, sensory deprivation and three time winner of britain in bloom, don’t forget to visit the pick your own strawberries just don’t tell anyone where you got them.
It’s not an entirely inaccurate description.
It bloody well is. Interrogation 1, now.
Creature’s voice is muffled until later - on the other side of the glass
Don’t worry, it’s a one way mirror. He can’t see you.
Oh. Can you hear us as well?
Yes. Thank you, Dan, I got that.
Nope. Right, as he can hear us we might be able to make this easier.

The make up is incredible. The skeleton stuff before was amazing, genuinely, I was a little scared. This is a bit over the top though, hard to take seriously. You lot are really into cosplay, aren’t you? I bet this Dan guy would’ve loved it.
It’s a portmanteau of costume and play. People make elaborate costumes to look like fictional characters, very popular. I’d like to do it one day...oh wait...I’m bodiless.
Your smart speaker is kind of maudlin.
Can I have my phone call now?
No. Show this idiot that you’re not in a costume.
But I am in a costume. That’s why you’re so annoyed with me. I’m wearing this human costume.
No. Not that costume. I mean show him that you’re actually not a human.
Aha, you can’t fool me. I am a human. My name is Dan.
Oh for Christ’s sake. We know you’e not Dan, we’ve just gone over all of this. You’re wearing what’s left of Dan.
So? He’s not Dan either, he’s Stan, You can’t trick me into thinking he’s Dan.
I know that. I bloody well know that. I’m not trying to trick you.
Then why’d you call him Dan? You, with the terrible haircut, what’s your name?
He’s not wrong, and he’s a trans-dimensional shadow beast that doesn’t even have hair, so, ouch.
Why’s he offended? He knew I was talking about him, so he knows it’s a terrible haircut.
Thank you. Wait, are you agreeing about my terrible hair?
You’re the one who just said it’s terrible.
Did you have to say my hair? There’s only two of us here and one of us has an eye-patch, a wooden leg, and a prosthetic arm.
You can’t go around pointing out things like that as a way to identify someone. It’s offensive. Isn’t it?

I don’t want to agree with it, but it does sting a little that someone would identify me as the bloke with a false leg, or that guy with the eye-patch. I’m a rounded person with my own hopes and dreams.
Oh my god. What the hell are you people going on about? Is this some kind of prank show? Sod it, you can use this in your bloopers--
Banging of doors, sound of struggling
What are you doing? Are you insane?
Stan, Stanley, this is a very bad idea.
Practical effects team finally getting work instead of CGI is great, but not at my expense.
Oh, goody, I can make myself a coat out of this one.
Door opens/creature voice changes from muffled to clear
Oh my god, what Is that smell?
Sulphur. Stay back, it’ll flay you in seconds.
Bang, bang, bang, swishing skittering noises
It has all these arms, and then it just went up the wall, like...like some kind of insect. Then it vanished? It just--
Shut up, Stan. Ness, can you see where he went?
Ew. No. The vents are proper minging.
It’s too big to fit in the vents. Vents aren’t like they show them in films you know, they’re much smaller. Unless you’ve got people sized vents here.
Will you shut up you bumbling idiot.
Major, Stan arrived today. Maybe we could have a little more patience.
In at he deep end, that’s how we do it. Never did me any harm.
Didn’t it? You do have quite a lot of serious injuries.
We’ve got a shadow creature running around in the vents.
I don’t think it’ll be running in them. Stan’s right, it’s a tight squeeze.
Exactly, all those films are lying to us.
Though it can run sort of like a centipede. Hm, judging from the noises, I would call it more of a complicated trot than a run, so, it’s trotting through the air vents.
Trotting? Trotting sounds friendly. Like a hairless shetland pony--
Whoops, it just took the security guard off corridor c.
Oh nope, he’s back. That’s good.
Well most of him’s back. Like, eighty percent, ah... It’s not great but it’s more than there was left of Dan, so that’s...something.
I suppose we’ve got about twenty percent of Dan if we count what that thing was wearing, so really, we’re still only one person down.
Shut up Ness. You, gear up.
You can’t seriously be expecting him to--
Haircut, put on the gear that has ‘Dan’ written on it, now.
Please don’t call me that. Don’t these belong to the...um, skin guy?
Listen, captain fivehead, just put them on and let’s just hope that the shadow creature decides not to pull off your skin and wear it as a suit.
There’s only one of them left, and she’s useless.
Ohh, five head because it’s bigger than a forehead, I get it.
What about the person on the speaker?
Don’t think I’m a smart speaker anymore? Anyway, I’m not a field operative, I’m actually more medical. So if you do get your skin pulled off, I’ll try to put it back on for you.
You don’t need to worry about, Ness. She can take care of herself.
Come on, Stan, take off your clothes.
Uh, that voice is creeping me out a little.
I’m about to strip off Ness.
Ew. Well done for killing the mood.
I’m a fine specimen of a man. Scars are supposed to be sexy, aren’t they?
There’s an upper limit, major, and you’re far beyond it. And Stan, there’s no actual need to take off your clothes, just put the overalls on.
The overalls are blessed, cursed, protected, all sorts of stuff. They’re also made of spider’s silk...oh, and they’re waterproof and stain resistant, which is more important than you’d think.
How did you get that much spider’s silk, isn’t it supposed to be-
Uh, the zip just zipped itself. That’s cool.
Haha, yes, very cool, self-zipping, definitely not a HR complaint.
You need to keep it on at all costs. Especially the broad spectrum ocular filters.
The goggles. You need to keep them, and the helmet, on at all costs.
Where are we going? Why would I need a helmet? At all costs? At what costs? Who would be paying?
If it’s all costs I suppose everyone would be paying.
No, it’s just his ‘all costs’, I’m not paying.
You can’t go dutch ‘at all costs’.
Check his tanks and hook him up.
For what, oof. What the hell. That is heavy.
[slightly muffled by helmet] okay. I think I’m ready.
Ready? Hah, we’ve got to visit the armoury yet.
Uh, major Argus, I think we might have a problem.
I know we have a problem Ness, we’ve got an invading creature--
It’s what? Why isn’t it just trying to escape?
A full scale invasion seems a more logical goal.
Grab a weapon we’re going to make this bastard regret what it did to Dan.
Background sound, a sudden ‘heurgh’ followed my.a wet thud.
[whistling] uh, Ralph, was that you? Ralph?...weird.
Sound of her pacing back and forth
Ralph. This isn’t funny. Last time with the clown make-up, honestly, that was not funny either. Ness had me on medication and she referred me to counselling. They were going to fire you...Ralph?
Skittering sound followed by a hiss

Ralph, you there? Oh come on, not the chainsaw guy this time. Seriously. You know what, Ralph, if you are doing something stupid I’m not letting you off this time. I’m going to let them fire you. This is work place bullying you son of a bitch.
Seriously? I’m not falling for that again. You can’t just keep doing the same prank, Ralph. What are you even supposed to be?
I’m...wait, do you really think I’m Ralph?
Aha, so this disguise is more effective than the last one. Interesting.
Honestly. The stupid voice ruins the whole effect. If you’d have kept your mouth shut I might have been scared, but this is...I’m kind of embarrassed for you. How much did that whole thing cost?
So you don’t think I look like this Ralph person?
Hilarious. Take the stupid costume off or I’m calling in support and you’re going to look like a right tit.
why would I look more like a right tit than a left tit?
Hi, Ness. Check out Ralph’s latest-
Not you as well, Ness. This is just too much.
Oh god, what is that voice, Ralph?
Is it not intimidating? I mean, what am I supposed to sound like? I learned english online so sometimes I wonder if it sounds a little twee.
Ralph is... No way, Ness, how did he rope you into this.
I would objectively, rather be brought back to life, and then boiled alive seventeen times over than plan a prank with Ralph. You know that.
Ah, there she goes. It’s sensible to have others quaking in their boots. Spreads the message that they should fear me. It’s all part of the theatre of things.
Oh yes, very scary. You do sound a little...
I mean, for a huge killing machine you’re just a bit...wet.
Wet? I am not. I was sent here as the tip of the spear, I am an elite force sent to break the line between the realms-
Try saying red lorry, yellow lorry ten times.
Fine, but only because I’m detail orientated. Red lorry, yellow lorry, red lorry, yellow lorry, red lorry...it’s tricky, let me try again--
Oh, try she sells sea shells on the sea shore-
It’s an all-purpose plasma inducing particle accelerator. Don’t point it at anything unless you want to destroy it.
Right. It looks like a hair dryer attached to a vacuum cleaner, why am I carrying it?
To stop the thing from interrogation 1. The thing you let out into the facility.
I’m not sure I’m the right person for this. Shouldn’t we call the police, the army, someone who-

There’s nobody more qualified to do this than me and you. And we can’t call any of them. How do you expect to explain it to them? Oh, hi there, I’m Stan, who should’ve been called Dan, and I was just granted the chance to live a little longer by Death as long as I work in Little Hellington defending the mortal realm from the terrors that lurk in the abyss and elsewhere.
I didn’t agree to any of that. I don’t want to defend the mortal realm.
Haven’t you got family, loved ones? Haven’t you got a decent moral conscience that doesn’t want that thing, and worse things like it, destroying the living world?
...I’d feel a little guilty about it, but I don’t see why it’s my job.
There we go. Wouldn’t you feel guilty if you just died instead.
But...I’m probably going to die, aren’t I?
Everyone’s going to die, Stan. If you’re not going to do things because you’re going to die you should just stop breathing.
If I stop breathing I’ll also die. Can’t I just... Keep breathing?
Ralph. You poor twisted bastard. The things this guy used to do.
There’s nothing left of him, oh it’s horrible, it’s...ugh...
Technically there’s quite a high percentage of him left, we’ve gone over this.
Just stand up straight and look forward. It’ll all slide down and you’ll be able to see again.
Oh, eurgh. It’s clearing...oh god, it’s dripping down the inside of the overalls...this is embarrassing. This probably happens all the time though, right?
It really doesn’t. I don’t think I’ve ever seen it happen before.
Yup. It scared the crap out of Ronnie, but she’s alive and cowering in the laundry room.
Security really living up to their role. At least it didn’t traumatise anyone else. We’ve already budgeted for her therapy thanks to Ralph...may he rest in peace. Where’s the creature?
It’s just around the corner having a crisis of confidence because I said it spoke funny.
Careful, the fact they all sound like simpering idiots is the only thing that stops them being genuinely terrifying. Okay newbie, lock and load.
I didn’t eat any carrots, why are there carrots?
Bloody security cameras are all down. How the hell does a shadow creature know how to mess up our security system.
Well, it’s a really old crappy system, and he said he’d done quite a lot of online courses.
They’ve been stealing our internet from across a transdimensional void? Hang on, how would they have devices, or our password, or...
Probably learnt how to do it all on the internet.
What? Ness, what do you think the internet is?
Did anyone tell the new Dan how to use the gun?
He’s called Stan, Ness, we really should stop calling him the new Dan.
We could call him the new Ralph.
Why would we do that? Nobody liked Ralph. He was an idiot.
Okay. We’ll stick with new Dan.
[beat] that seems fair. How are they doing?
The major is taking point and they’re passing the laundry room, about to reach vault five. The creature is ahead of them though, and I imagine-
It’s going to be trying to open the door.
Well it’s not going to find that easy, the security-
It’s already opened it, and it’s seen the Major. Oh dear. How many parts can you replace for him before he stops working?
He’ll be fine. It’ll take a lot more than one shadow creature to take down Argus. He’s dealt with worse.
Okay, keep that end pointed at the creature, flick the two switches on the right side and you’ll feel it starting to power up.
Good. Now if I say fire, press that button.

Because it does a lot of different things. Now pull yourself together. We round this corner and it’s going to be right there. Whatever happens we have to stop it from letting anything else through the barrier.
No matter what. At all costs. If you have to blast me as well, then you do it, got it?
Right. At all costs. There’s a lot of at all costs stuff going on. Sounds expensive.
Fate of the world stuff tends to come with a high cost. You’ll be fine, it’s only that one thing and we’ve got it pinned down.
Right, it’ll be fine. Let’s do this.
Just in case why don’t you walk a little more to the right...and front.
Wait, I don’t want to be in front of you.
That’s what I’m worried about. Professionals don’t hesitate to shoot through other people. You said at all costs. I’d be collateral damage. I’ve seen films.
I promise not to intentionally kill you
Uh, why don’t we ask the speaker lady to check first?
Ness? No, she’ll be hiding back at the stairs. Wouldn’t be surprised if she’s gone up to the post office to be honest. Right. Three, two, one-
Turn around the corner, sound of weapons ker-chunking, whirring etc.
Don’t move another muscle, or whatever it is you move...is it shadow?
Shadow is the absence of light. How would that even work?
Stop what you’re doing or I’ll be redecorating the walls.
You’ll...what does that mean? Are you going to viciously force me into an NVQ in interior design?
Is that what the button with the paintbrush on it does? Like wallpaper paste?
No, that’s...it’s not important. I mean, I’lll shoot and you’ll end up being splattered all over the place.
Yeah. And if he misses, I won’t.
Oh. Are you a better shot?
Uh. I don’t know, actually. I’ve never even seen one of these before.

I’m not entirely sure what’s going on. I’m fifty-fifty on whether this is a dream, or some kind of next level prank. I suppose it could be a psychological experiment, highly unethical if it is, I mean--
Well, you’re certainly a talker. Look this has been fun, but I am leaving now. You said I’m not allowed to be here and so I’m going home. That’s okay isn’t it?
What? How exactly is this supposed to work? I came here, you stopped me and said I wasn’t allowed to be here. Immigration, visa, blah, blah, so I’m saying okay fine, I’ll go back.
But our dead security officer on this side of the line changes things.
Ah. Well that was self defence.
What are you doing with the door handle?
Just leaning against it, nothing to worry about.
Fine. I’ll come with you. I’m not complaining.
Stan, keep your weapon pointed at that door. You, cockroach, turn around, arms against the wall. All of them.
Shoot the damn gun and shut the door. Shut the door
Howling sounds, wind, thunder, ominous chanting
Shut the door, Stan, shut the door before they come in.
Oh no, no, no, this prank is terrible. You’re bleeding, is it dead? Are you dying?
Right. The door. I just have to shut the door...
Come on, Stan, you can do it.
Good work. Now, can you carry the Major back towards the stairs?
This...this door has a sign on it for a toilet, I mean, that’s a men’s room sign.
Good, you can still see. You need to help the Major.
It could’ve been. Still wasn’t great though. I mean, Ralph and Dan are dead.
Ralph isn’t that big a loss really and you don’t know Dan’s dead.
He was the one who had a cockroach monster wearing his skin as a terrible disguise.
Yeah... When you say it like that...
But, I was given the impression I’d die in a horrific traffic sex toy accident if I left.
Exactly! You’ve got a choice. Stick around and plug the gaps in Little Hellsgate, or the sex toy thing.
It’s the same one we’ve all got.
You’re all going to be killed by robotic twerking if you leave?
No. If it were that specific it would be ridiculous... But we’ll all die (BEAT) in embarrassing ways.

Nobody has to share that. It’s private. It’s information that nobody needs to know about while it’s hypothetical. If one day you decide to walk out there, we’ll all know just how embarrassing it was going to be.
Oh yeah, I mean, makes my eyes water thinking about it.
I’m just supposed to accept that leaving means Death?

You don’t have to accept it, go find out. Of course, even if you can leave, do you want to? I’m sure whatever you were doing before was far more worthwhile than defending the people of the world who live in blissful ignorance of the horrors trying to break into this world. Look at what you did on your first day, even if you did it really badly, you stopped the world being invaded by billions of shadow creatures who would have devoured every living thing on this planet within a week.
I... You’re asking me to put my life on the line.

Hah! I’m not asking you to do anything you can sod off right now for all I care. You can stay to do something good, or because you’re frightened that you’ll die if you leave. Nobody needs to know if it’s selfless or selfish, and none of us care. Now, pass me that newspaper, I’m off to the bog, and I’ll be a while.
Wait. He can’t mean that toilet. That’s the portal to the shadow things.
It doesn’t work like that. It’s fine in there now...though I wouldn’t go in any time soon. The major... Just let it air.
So this is some kind of gateway to the shadow realm?
Gateway, terminal, isn’t it the same thing?
No. A gate just goes to one place. There are all sorts of gates here, to all sorts of places.
You know how sometimes things get banished to another realm, or exorcised.
Uh, in fictional stories I guess.
Well, how do they get in? All those otherworldly things, come from somewhere, right?
Exactly quite a few of them get in through here, or they used to anyway. Little Hellsgate is where things get shallow.
Everyone talks about the depths of hell, but what they need to worry about is the shallows, because that’s where the mortal realm meets hell’s shores.
Just the edge of it, you’re basically on a beach, but you’re not on holiday, and you work in immigration now.
One thing’s bugging me about today.
How did Dan end up on the other side? And how did that thing get in.
That door only opens from this side. Why would Dan let that thing in?

Next time in Little Hellsgate, miss o’toole is enraged as a mysterious canine continues to leave ‘presents’ on her carefully manicured lawn. The father lily-white is having a car boot sale in the church grounds, but who would want to buy only a car boot? And scandal has arisen, as the village shop has begun selling chewing gum, is it even confectionary? Oh, and beneath the village post office lurks a thinning between this world and multitudes of others filled with creatures from your worst nightmares. See you soon...
